grant.sync_suppressed vs binding.pending_scope kind is decided from the user's applicable grant rows per role regardless of whether the role is held (MembershipScope.row_scopes/2): role names are unique per tenant so a role is bound to exactly one group, and a user not in that group can only hold scoped rows for it as user-principal rows; the held-aware snapshot would classify that as deny. The widening decision itself uses the held-aware snapshots (design 3.9).
insert_membership_audit/6 keeps arity 6: its 4th argument is now the tuple {before_roles, before_scope_snapshot}.

A mix compile was started once while the mixlock dir had just been created by another session (race: the ls and the compile ran in one command); it only compiled. All later mix runs held the lock which I created and removed.
